title: Leanne Morgan - The Time Of Our Lives Tour
seo_title: Leanne Morgan: The Time Of Our Lives Tour in Springfield
description: Leanne Morgan brings her stand-up comedy show, The Time of Our Lives Tour, to Springfield, Missouri, one of 32 markets across the United States. She is known for her Netflix special I'm Every Woman and has sold out over 100 theater and arena shows. It takes place Sunday, November 22, 2026 at 7:00 PM at Great Southern Bank Arena, with doors opening at 5:30 PM.
